rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

content.GLOSS: A male parent; a source or originator; the first person of the Trinity; a title of respect and authority within a family or spiritual community.
content.ART_PROMPT: A warm, close-up oil painting of a weathered hand resting gently but firmly on a younger person's shoulder; golden hour lighting, soft focus background suggesting an ancient stone dwelling, evoking protection, guidance, and inheritance.
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Look at the top 3 cards of the Tower; add 1 to your hand and put the rest in Sheol.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him.
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received a spirit of adoption. When we cry, 'Abba! Father!'
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Psalm 103:13 — “As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him.”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Romans 8:15 — “For you did not receive a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received a spirit of adoption. When we cry, 'Abba! Father!'”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: The Hebrew 'Av' is likely mimetic of infant babbling, similar to 'Papa' in English.
In the ancient Near East, the 'bet av' (house of the father) was the primary social and legal unit.
Jesus used the intimate Aramaic term 'Abba' in prayer, revolutionizing the believer's access to God.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
